metadata.title: Micron, Musk, and Memory. A Big Prediction Is Lifting the Stock.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron, Musk, and Memory. A Big Prediction Is Lifting the Stock.
Micron Technology is on the rebound. The memory-chip company is gaining from renewed artificial-intelligence optimism and a major prediction about a robot-driven future from Elon Musk.
